title: Position embedding for a DNF term
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, with distinct literal indices, and let $w$ be a natural number such that the width of $T$ is at most $w$. Then the literal positions of $T$ embed injectively into the first $w$ positions, preserving their indices.
